$comment: 'CPA or CMA' is an either/or: the hard filter is array containment, so putting both ids in required_certifications would exclude everyone with only one. It stays in must_haves as text and required_certifications is empty. SAP is the only software hard filter (Power BI is preferred). Aerospace is the customers' industry, not the company's, and is not a taxonomy term anyway. 'As soon as possible' is not a date. Of '10 or more years ... with at least 5 in a manufacturing environment' the overall 10 is min_years_experience; the 5 stays in the must-have text.

requirements.title: Controller
must_haves: 10 or more years of accounting experience with at least 5 in a manufacturing environment
Standard costing experience in a make-to-order or foundry setting
SAP experience (S/4HANA or ECC) as the system of record
Willingness to work on-site in Toledo five days a week
nice_to_haves: Power BI or similar reporting tools
Experience with an ERP implementation or upgrade
